name: WWT Castle Espie Play Areas
description: The Wildwood woodland play area with a zip line and the Scrabo play tower (7+), a climbing wall at the Limestone Pavilion, the Secret Swamp with a wobbly bridge and balance beams, and the indoor Brent play barn for children under 115 cm. Open 10am to 4.30pm.
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the centre's tickets page for prices. WWT members get in free at all 10 wetland centres.
